title: The Canon of Layered Folds
summary: A canon on stacking folds of space layer upon layer to guard the body and collapse the stack on a foe.

title: Treatise on Open Frames
summary: A treatise on raising frames of qi that mark out a volume of space the user may then cut hold or break.

title: Manual of Stowed Space
summary: A manual on keeping weapons and stones in folds of space about the body and loosing them in a rush.

title: The Orbit Compendium
summary: A compendium on circling a fixed point in space so the body swings round it faster than a foe can turn.

title: Reckoning of the Far Hand
summary: A reckoning of reaching across a great distance with the hand and its blows as if the foe stood close.

title: Canon of Sheared Planes
summary: A canon on cutting flat planes of space and sliding the body or the foe along the cut.

title: The Slipstream Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of slipping out of the space a blow occupies and returning into the space behind it.

title: Treatise of the Torn Distance
summary: A treatise on tearing narrow rifts in the space between two points and driving force or bodies through them.

title: Manual of the Closed Cell
summary: A manual on shutting a small cell of space about a foe and tightening it until the foe cannot move.
